summary: Phase 0 of terminology standardization is a clean, entirely additive diff (new scripts, new YAML/JSON registry artifacts, one MASTER_INDEX.yaml append, and a rewritten PROGRESS.md) with no changes to .github/workflows/**, migrations, schema, auth, or other tier2-triggering paths, so tier1 is the correct classification. I independently verified the claims rather than trusting the self-report: re-ran generate_variable_dictionary.py and it reproduced the committed VARIABLE_DICTIONARY_2026-07-24.yaml byte-for-byte (320 entries, 182 real/138 synthetic), confirming the dictionary is genuinely script-generated and not hand-authored; re-ran TERMINOLOGY_GUARDRAIL_2026-07-24.py against the same 3 real compliance-tracker files and got an identical 36-finding result: 29 placeholder_company_name and 7 placeholder_email_domain matches. I checked VARIABLE_DICTIONARY_SOURCE_ROWS_2026-07-24.json and the generated dictionary for sensitive-data leakage and found none: all password/passcode/hash columns are properly redacted to a fixed marker and never used as example values, and the exposed values are dev/seed data already present in the repo's own db/seed.ts (org_001/Acme Corp, *@acme.com), not new PII exposure. All new/modified YAML and JSON files parse cleanly and both Python scripts compile without syntax errors. MASTER_INDEX.yaml gets exactly one new, non-duplicated registry entry. The guardrail's regex patterns (especially the bare-ISO-date and PAN-shape rules) will likely produce high false-positive rates if ever run repo-wide, but this is explicitly scoped as design+smoke-test only in this phase, not CI-wired, so it is not a blocking issue now -- flagged for the rollout phase's own review.
issues: TERMINOLOGY_GUARDRAIL_2026-07-24.py's hardcoded_iso_date and indian_pan_literal regex patterns are broad (any bare YYYY-MM-DD date; any 5-letter+4-digit+1-letter uppercase token) and will likely generate significant false positives if run repo-wide in a later CI-enforcement phase; worth tightening or adding an exemption mechanism before that rollout, not a Phase 0 blocker.
